name: honest-exit
description: Make silent shell failures loud: a glob that matched nothing, a command missing from the agent's shell, or a pipe that hid a failing exit status gets a note the model reads and a peach pixel-art toast.

rewrite.title: Rewrite risky commands
rewrite.description: Before a Bash call runs, quote unquoted globs in --flag=*.x arguments and prefix set -o pipefail when a test, lint or build command is piped into tail. The model is told about every rewrite. Off by default.
